native_EQA_run_states.intake: input inventory incomplete; no execution authority
native_EQA_run_states.running: only an authorized live attempt may report running
native_EQA_run_states.ready_with_tracked_items: requires adopted residual-risk policy and retained receipt
native_EQA_run_states.released: external authorized release observation only; never a CLI effect
native_EQA_run_states.post_publication_case: separate owner-controlled case; no ordinary release bypass
native_EQA_run_states.blocked: prohibited effect, critical failure, invalid authority or fixity failure

new_term: ready_for_human_acceptance is a claim-scoped recommendation, not the work-item accepted state or a native released transition.
mapping_rule: Store native family status and scoped recommendation alongside the canonical yard task/result outcome; do not overwrite one namespace with another. A successful reconcile returning hold is an evaluated operation, not an accepted work item.
